A hundred [[Meter/Legends|meter]] '''replica''' of the [[Geharran Royal Palace]] stood on [[Meihanna Island]] on [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nehanna|mother]], [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Ebrahi]] resided in the replica.<ref name="Strongholds" />
